description: This Java class 'StaticContentUrlProvider' generates URLs for static content resources based on the current HttpServletRequest context and configuration properties.

classes.name: StaticContentUrlProvider
classes.description: A utility class that provides URL strings for static content, based on the request context and configured URL prefix.

methods.name: StaticContentUrlProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with the current HttpServletRequest object.

methods.name: pathAsContentUrlString
methods.description: Returns the complete URL string to access a static resource given its resource path.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Lazily retrieves and caches the URL prefix for static content based on the current request.
